semiconductor_relevance: Medium — BMI Co., Ltd. distributes critical components and tools that support semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: BMI Co., Ltd. is a distributor of essential components and tools for the semiconductor industry, including Piezocon Sensors, GAS Mixing Systems, and APEX systems from Veeco Flow Technologies. They also supply oxide and SOI wafers, CMP and chemical filter products, and silicon injectors and boat products, enhancing production performance in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Distribution of Piezocon Sensors and GAS Mixing Systems
Supply of oxide and SOI wafers
Provision of CMP and chemical filter products
Distribution of silicon injectors and boat products
